item.title: NEW: Google Patches Eighth Actively Exploited Chrome Zero-Day This Year
item.description:
Headline: Google Patches Eighth Actively Exploited Chrome Zero-Day This Year

Summary:
Google has released an emergency security update for Chrome to address a high-severity use-after-free vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-125350. The flaw, located in the XML component, is confirmed to be actively exploited in the wild, marking the eighth Chrome zero-day patched in 2026. The update, version 157.0.8103.50/.51, also fixes seven other high-severity issues. Users are urged to update their browsers immediately to mitigate the risk of arbitrary code execution.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Patch Management, Threat Intelligence

Meta Description: Google patches the eighth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026, CVE-2026-125350, a high-severity use-after-free flaw. Update to the latest version now.

item.title: NEW: France Blames Iran's IRGC for Cyber Sabotage on Supermarkets
item.description:
Headline: France Blames Iran's IRGC for Cyber Sabotage on Supermarkets

Summary:
The French government has officially attributed a series of disruptive cyberattacks on nearly 700 supermarkets to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). The attacks, which occurred in October, manipulated refrigeration systems, causing widespread food spoilage. France described the incident as an "unprecedented" act of sabotage and is seeking EU sanctions against the responsible IRGC-linked cyber unit, known as 'Shahid Kaveh' or 'CyberAveng3rs'.

Severity: High

Categories: Cyberattack, Threat Actor, Industrial Control Systems

Meta Description: France officially blames Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) for a major cyberattack that sabotaged supermarket refrigeration systems across the country.

item.title: NEW: SAP Patches Four Critical Flaws with Maximum 10.0 CVSS Score
item.description:
Headline: SAP Patches Four Critical Flaws with Maximum 10.0 CVSS Score

Summary:
SAP's November Security Patch Day includes fixes for 35 vulnerabilities, four of which are rated with the maximum CVSS score of 10.0. These critical flaws, discovered by security firm Onapsis and named ICM2SHELL and PROXYGATE, could allow an unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution on affected SAP NetWeaver, Web Dispatcher, and Gateway systems. While not yet exploited in the wild, a working exploit has been developed, and customers are urged to patch immediately.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Patch Management, Threat Intelligence

item.title: UPDATE: Cyber-Physical Attack Hits 700 French Supermarkets via Refrigerators
item.description:
Headline: Cyber-Physical Attack Hits 700 French Supermarkets via Refrigerators

Summary:
A large-scale cyber-physical attack has crippled over 700 supermarkets across France, including major chains like Coopérative U and Carrefour Market. Attackers remotely manipulated Danfoss refrigeration controllers, causing them to overheat to temperatures as high as 50°C (122°F). This act of sabotage resulted in massive spoilage of fresh and frozen food, operational shutdowns, and even small fires. The attack exploited vulnerabilities in obsolete equipment that was no longer receiving security updates. The incident, which has also affected supply chains in several other European countries and the US, highlights the severe real-world consequences of unsecured Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and IoT devices in critical infrastructure.

Severity: High

Categories: Cyberattack, Industrial Control Systems, Supply Chain Attack

Article Type: NewsArticle

Meta Description: A cyberattack on Danfoss refrigeration controllers at 700 French supermarkets caused massive food spoilage and fires, highlighting risks in unsecured OT systems.

item.title: NEW: Bitter APT Targets South Asia with New C++/Rust PapRAT Backdoor
item.description:
Headline: Bitter APT Targets South Asia with New C++/Rust PapRAT Backdoor

Summary:
The cyber espionage group Bitter (APT-C-08) is conducting a new campaign targeting organizations in South Asia with a previously undocumented remote access trojan (RAT) named PapRAT. The malware, which exists in both C++ and Rust versions, is delivered through complex infection chains involving malicious LNK files, VHDX disk images, and WebDAV servers. PapRAT's capabilities include command execution, file manipulation, and screen capture, demonstrating the threat actor's evolving sophistication and use of living-off-the-land techniques.

Severity: High

Categories: Threat Actor, Malware, Cyberattack

item.title: NEW: Microsoft Revises Windows 11 Paint RCE Flaw, Lowers CVSS Score
item.description:
Headline: Microsoft Revises Windows 11 Paint RCE Flaw, Lowers CVSS Score

Summary:
Microsoft has revised the details for CVE-2026-83844, a remote code execution vulnerability in the Windows 11 Paint app. The CVSS score was lowered from 8.1 to 7.0 after clarifying the attack vector is 'Local', requiring a user to open a malicious file, not 'Network'. The vulnerability, an out-of-bounds read, has no evidence of in-the-wild exploitation. The definitive patch is confirmed to be in Paint version 11.2609.401.0, available via the Microsoft Store.

Severity: Medium

Categories: Vulnerability, Patch Management

Meta Description: Microsoft has lowered the severity of CVE-2026-83844, a Windows 11 Paint RCE bug, to CVSS 7.0, clarifying that it requires local user interaction to exploit.

item.title: NEW: Critical GitLab RCE Flaw (CVE-2026-97229) Actively Exploited
item.description:
Headline: Critical GitLab RCE Flaw (CVE-2026-97229) Actively Exploited

Summary:
A critical, unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in GitLab (CVE-2026-97229) is being actively exploited in the wild. The flaw allows attackers to run arbitrary code by submitting a crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration file. Due to evidence of active exploitation, CISA has added the vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, mandating federal agencies to patch. Administrators of affected GitLab CE/EE versions are urged to update immediately.

Severity: Critical

Categories: Vulnerability, Cyberattack, Patch Management
